key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:A76E
name: append_record_if_room
description: Copies a two-word record from a fixed source into a table slot selected by a counter, but only while the counter is below eighty. The counter is incremented after each copy.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:A79C
name: process_slots_two_through_five
description: Sets a status flag, then calls a sub-routine for each slot index from two to five after storing that index in a byte field. The flag is cleared again before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:A7C8
name: scan_adjacent_cells_and_dispatch
description: Loads a cell-table value into a byte field, then checks the two neighbouring indices around a computed position, skipping any with a masked bit set, and calls a handler for each match. A second pass walks a list backwards and calls the handler on each non-empty entry, returning the last handler result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:A9A2
name: dispatch_cells_by_mode
description: Selects a traversal pattern from a mode value between zero and six. Modes one and five step through eight index offsets, mode six tests one derived index, and the default case walks outward in one direction, calling a handler on each unoccupied cell it reaches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:ABBE
name: evaluate_candidates_around_midpoint
description: Walks two candidate lists forward and backward, calling a handler on each flagged entry, then evaluates a stored position and, if the threshold test passes, computes the midpoint of a stored range. It then visits the cells immediately either side of that midpoint.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:AE1C
name: fetch_next_record_or_default
description: Takes the next saved two-word record from a fixed table and advances the read index while records remain. Once the table is exhausted it loads a fixed fallback pair instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:AE58
name: extract_lowest_bit
description: Returns the least significant bit of the low sixteen bits of its 32-bit argument, as a 16-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:AE68
name: build_weighted_direction_tables
description: Scans a 120-entry table, accumulating a running total and a difference term, then fills two 8-by-8 scratch tables with weighted sums taken along step directions. The pseudo-code is truncated after the table fill, so its final return value is not fully shown.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:BC08
name: tally_helper_hits_across_bits
description: Shifts a 16-bit argument right one bit at a time until it is zero, calling a subroutine on each pass and counting the passes where that subroutine returns non-zero. The count is returned as the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:BC36
name: compute_negated_weighted_sum
description: Calls a subroutine three times and returns a 32-bit value whose low word is the negated sum of the three results weighted by eight, twenty and forty. The high word carries the upper bits of the forty-weighted term.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:BCC4
name: sum_indexed_table_entries
description: Computes a flat index from two packed arguments using a row length of 240 and a block stride of 1440. It returns the sum of one word from a second table selected by the first argument and one word from the main table at the computed index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:BD0A
name: merge_masked_word_pair
description: Stores the complement of one table word as a mask and merges it into two adjacent words: one is OR-combined with the masked other, and the other is then masked. It returns the difference between two subroutine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:BDE6
name: merge_second_mask_word_pair
description: Variant of the adjacent-word masked merge that uses a complemented word from a second table as the mask. It writes the combined bits into two adjacent words, clears one of them, and returns the difference between two subroutine results.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:BF2C
name: compute_flagged_value_delta
description: Computes a signed value from a table lookup and the flag byte of its second argument, applying a direction-dependent adjustment and a fixed offset. It returns the difference between two table-derived values, and the branch taken depends on which flag value is present.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C198
name: run_bounded_poll_loop
description: Sets a busy flag and invokes two indirect service routines through a function-pointer table. It then loops until a counter passed in its argument is reached or a state word is set, calling a subroutine on each pass, and finally clears the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C300
name: check_pending_wait_condition
description: Returns zero when a flag word is clear, otherwise it calls a subroutine and returns one unless a counter is below a second counter and a table entry equals one. In that case it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C33A
name: locate_tagged_entries_per_group
description: Fills a 24-entry table of paired words from a template value, then sets two slot words to minus one. It searches two groups of eight entries for tagged matches and stores the index of each match in the slot belonging to its group.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C41C
name: run_routine_and_store_result
description: Sets a status word from a flag byte and clears a counter, then calls a subroutine with the argument. It stores that result into a state word only while the counter is still zero, and returns the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C46E
name: record_undecompiled_routine
description: No pseudo-code was available because decompilation timed out, so only the facts are known. The routine has 122 instructions, is called by two routines and calls four others.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C604
name: process_candidate_slots_in_order
description: Reads a per-entry flag and either copies a stored entry into a candidate slot and calls the evaluator, or moves on. It then iterates over two candidate slots and the stored list, calling subroutines and returning early once one reports success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:C91A
name: run_step_loop_stack_swap
description: Pushes the current entry onto a list of up to twenty-three slots, then loops while a subroutine returns zero. Each pass swaps two stored indices, calls a subroutine with a negated value, and calls indirect service routines before returning one when a stop flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:CC4A
name: push_pair_into_slot_pair
description: Stores a two-word pair into the slot record for the current level, moving the existing first entry into the second slot when it is occupied. The store happens only when the flag byte of the second argument is set and the slot does not already hold the same first word, and subroutines decide whether an occupied slot may be replaced.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:CD30
name: test_slot_against_entries
description: Returns one as soon as a subroutine test on the current slot passes. Otherwise, when the state word allows it, it tests the slot against each of two stored entries and returns zero if none passes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:CDEC
name: update_maximum_and_check_bound
description: Returns one only when the argument does not exceed the first stored bound, and in that case raises a second stored word to the argument when the argument is larger. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:CE26
name: search_slot_candidates_with_cutoff
description: Handles one step of a candidate search. In one mode it records a result slot after a service call, and in the other it evaluates the current slot, updates a best-value word and stores a candidate, comparing candidate pairs against a cutoff. It returns zero to keep searching and one to stop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:D28E
name: apply_level_one_score_adjustment
description: At level one it classifies two returned values into a category from zero to three and adds a scaled bonus to two stored score words, returning one if a value exceeds a limit. At deeper levels it returns one when a subroutine result exceeds one, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:D374
name: store_entry_and_bound
description: Calls a subroutine, copies the current entry into the slot for this level, and at level zero copies a stored bound into a shared word. When a mode byte equals five, that bound is replaced by a value from a separate word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:D3E4
name: iterate_level_slot_range
description: Sets a level-specific flag, then calls a subroutine for each value from two to five stored in a byte field. It returns one as soon as a call returns non-zero, and otherwise clears the flag and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:D45A
name: scan_cells_until_one_succeeds
description: Records an entry for the current level, then tests the neighbouring indices of its position that carry a matching tag, calling a subroutine for each and stopping early on success. It then walks the stored list backwards, calling the test on each non-empty entry, and returns zero if none succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:D6D2
name: dispatch_cells_by_kind
description: Selects a traversal pattern from a kind value between one and six. Kinds one and five visit eight index offsets, kinds two to four walk a ray of free cells, and kind six tests one derived index with a range adjustment, returning one as soon as a subroutine call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:DAF2
name: test_fixed_pairs_for_success
description: Sets a status word and mode byte, then tests a fixed table of pairs from the highest index down, calling a subroutine on each and stopping when the call and a follow-up check both succeed. It returns one on that success and zero if no pair qualifies.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:DBE6
name: test_midpoint_neighbours_when_ready
description: When the previous level's mode byte is six and a computed value exceeds thirty-one, it sets this level's mode and computes the midpoint of a stored range. It then tests each unmasked index either side of that midpoint with a subroutine and a follow-up check, returning one on the first success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:DD7E
name: unwind_level_entries
description: Saves the current level, then steps back through the levels down to zero, swapping two stored indices and calling a subroutine on each entry. If a flag word is set, it also calls the subroutine on the next entry before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:DDFE
name: replay_level_entries_forward
description: Advances to the next level and, while it is below the saved level, calls a subroutine on each entry going forward and swaps two stored indices after each call. A flagged entry is handled first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:DE7A
name: wait_and_clear_pending_state
description: If a pending word is non-zero, it either calls an indirect service with a fixed delay when a timer word is clear, or sets the state word to one when the pending word equals two, and then clears the pending word. The routine references the text 'Jay was wrong #1'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:E084
name: compute_direction_and_emit_steps
description: Computes a direction code from the difference between two packed position bytes, using their upper and lower three-bit fields, and then issues calls to an indirect routine with code pairs chosen by that direction. The pseudo-code is truncated partway through, so the remaining branches are not described.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F17C
name: call_routine_seven_eight
description: Calls one routine twice, passing a fixed table address with the codes seven and eight, and stores each returned value in its own word. The routine is entered through a handler pointer held in data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F1B4
name: run_pair_if_flag_clear
description: Calls two routines when a status word is zero, and does nothing when that word is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F1D4
name: post_status_message_block
description: Calls a routine and, when a status word is non-zero, fills a fixed-layout block of global words with a header, a pointer, a value taken from the first argument and a trailer code. The trailer code is chosen by the low word of the second argument, and the target of the block is not identified by the pseudo-code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F1EC
name: start_audio_channel_one_playback
description: Programs audio channel one by writing its sample pointer, length, period and volume registers, then writes the DMA control and interrupt enable values. A flag word selects one of two configurations, and the register notes show that set bits enable and cleared bits disable.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F248
name: start_audio_channel_zero_playback
description: Programs audio channel zero by writing its sample pointer, length, period and volume registers from successive argument words, then writes the DMA control and interrupt enable values. The register notes show that set bits enable and cleared bits disable.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F2A0
name: enable_selected_audio_channel_dma
description: Writes the DMA control value and a paired interrupt control value for audio channel zero when the argument's low word is zero, or for channel one otherwise. It then calls an indirect routine with the code two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F2BC
name: enable_audio_channel_zero_dma
description: Writes the DMA control and interrupt enable values for audio channel zero, then calls an indirect routine with the code two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F2DA
name: silence_both_audio_channels
description: Writes the DMA control value for channels zero and one, clears both channel volume registers, and then calls two routines with the codes eight and seven and the stored values. One of the called routines is a library stub.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F31A
name: set_channel_state_by_count
description: Writes a fixed value into one state field of the structure and counts its calls in a flag word. On the first call it copies a stored value and the count fifty into two fields, and on later calls it sets a different value and the count two.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F33E
name: copy_value_to_slot_b
description: Copies a stored value into one structure field and sets the adjacent count field to fifty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F34E
name: set_alternate_state_by_count
description: Writes a fixed value into a state field and counts its calls in a flag word. On the first call it copies a stored value and the count fifty into two fields, and on later calls it sets a different value and the count one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F372
name: copy_value_to_slot_a
description: Copies a stored value into a structure field at a different offset from its sibling routine and sets the adjacent count field to fifty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F5DA
name: lookup_masked_value_in_range
description: Returns zero when a position field is 95 or more. Otherwise it searches a list of mask entries for one that matches a status field, reads a value from the table it points to at that position, and ORs in 224 when bit seven of the status field is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F5F2
name: lookup_table_value
description: Searches a list of mask entries for one matching a status field, then reads a word from the table it points to at the index passed in the data register. If bit seven of the status field is set, the value is ORed with 224.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F62A
name: check_disk_port_setup
description: No pseudo-code was available because decompilation timed out, so the routine is described from its facts only. It references text about a disk port failure, the trackdisk device name, a drive access error and a port name, and it calls five routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F74C
name: store_two_words_and_clear
description: Writes the low and high words of its 32-bit argument to two consecutive global locations, then writes zero to a third global location.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F76A
name: write_long_then_clear_global
description: Writes its 32-bit argument to a global location and then writes zero to the same location.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F780
name: transfer_span_in_chunks
description: Splits a length argument into chunks of 512 units, calling a routine for each chunk with advancing source and destination values and handling any remainder. The first step computes an initial chunk size from a global word and the 512-unit limit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F89A
name: emit_chunked_span_rows
description: Computes an initial value from a global word and then, for each 512-unit chunk of the length argument, calls a routine with that value and the current source address, advancing both. The routine was reached only as gap data decoded as code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F8C2
name: emit_chunks_until_length_used
description: Repeats a 512-unit step that calls a routine with the current pointer and source values, advances a global word by 512, and moves both pointers forward until the remaining length is no longer positive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F8F8
name: flush_pending_span_or_global
description: If a global word is zero and a second global is set, it calls two routines and then passes a fixed address and the second global to a third routine. Otherwise it passes the first global to one routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F914
name: flush_stored_span_when_set
description: When a stored global word is set, it calls two routines, then calls one routine with a fixed address and one with the stored word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:F93E
name: advance_span_cursor_and_emit
description: Advances a global cursor by its remainder within a 512-unit block and recomputes a derived value. When the cursor is zero it emits a span through a routine, and otherwise it passes a 512-unit length to an indirect routine before updating the cursor.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FA06
name: post_block_command_with_position
description: Writes a fixed command word, a 512-unit length, the second argument and the first argument scaled by 512 into global locations, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FA3A
name: post_alternate_block_command
description: Writes the command word 32771, a 512-unit length, the second argument and the first argument scaled by 512 into global locations, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FA6C
name: retry_write_protected_disk_prompt
description: Repeatedly issues a request and checks a status word, and while the status is non-zero it calls a routine and an indirect service with a fixed delay before trying again. The routine references the text 'Disk is write protected, try again.'

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FAA4
name: forward_single_routine_call
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FAD0
name: wait_for_battlechess_disk
description: Polls a status word until the expected disk is present, pausing through an indirect service between attempts and then pausing again once the wait completes. The routine references the text 'Insert the BattleChess disk.'

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FB4C
name: request_block_read_with_restore
description: Saves a 13-word block of a fixed region to the stack, issues a sequence of port commands with a block size of 4096 and a fixed length, then restores the saved words. It returns one on success and zero on failure, and references the text 'Battle Chess'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FC58
name: read_save_block_with_restore
description: Saves a 13-word block to the stack, computes a length from a global word plus 433, issues the port command sequence with a fixed large size and that length, and restores the block. It returns one on success and zero on failure, and references the text 'ChessSaves'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a4]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a4].adf:BattleChess:0:FD34
name: save_global_and_copy_block
description: Saves a global word into a stack slot, copies a 13-word block from a stack area into a fixed location, and returns one.
